capture_limitations: This is a concise review record, not a raw HTML/PDF capture. content_hash hashes these exact review-record bytes. Running source_sync sync will store raw response bytes and replace this baseline hash only for sections it can verify.
source_recommendation_assessment: OWASP describes SSRF risk when an API fetches remote resources from user-supplied URIs without validating the destination. The control therefore requires destination restrictions and safe URL validation before server-side fetching.
